name: budabit-calendar-widget
description: BudaBit inline widget for featuring a community calendar event

scripts.manifest:after: budabit-generate --title 'Featured Calendar Event' --type tool --app-url '${WIDGET_APP_URL:-https://example.com/budabit-calendar-widget/index.html}' --icon 'https://example.com/budabit-calendar-widget/icon.png' --image 'https://example.com/budabit-calendar-widget/preview.png' --identifier 'featured-calendar-event' --version '0.1.7' --changelog 'Use host navigation for event links' --permissions 'community:checkWriteCapabilities,community:queryEvents,community:querySharedConfig,community:publishSharedConfig,ui:toast,ui:navigate' --slot-type 'community-home-after-quicklinks' --slot-label 'Featured event' --output 'dist/widget-after'
scripts.manifest:before: budabit-generate --title 'Featured Calendar Event' --type tool --app-url '${WIDGET_APP_URL:-https://example.com/budabit-calendar-widget/index.html}' --icon 'https://example.com/budabit-calendar-widget/icon.png' --image 'https://example.com/budabit-calendar-widget/preview.png' --identifier 'featured-calendar-event' --version '0.1.7' --changelog 'Use host navigation for event links' --permissions 'community:checkWriteCapabilities,community:queryEvents,community:querySharedConfig,community:publishSharedConfig,ui:toast,ui:navigate' --slot-type 'community-home-before-quicklinks' --slot-label 'Featured event' --output 'dist/widget-before'
